about: Per-prompt C1 results of the frozen prototypes on these files (FROZEN-v3.txt): 'v52' = premise_proto_v52.install (USED_SWITCH_SPEAKS True); 'speaking' = premise_proto_v43.install alone, then v5.2's final filter (_library_kwarg), the noted names when USED_SWITCH_SPEAKS is False; 'recorded' = v52 minus speaking. Battery v52 rows equal blind-results-b1-v52-dev.json and blind-results-b2-v52-dev.json; speaking rows equal the v43 rows of blind-results.json and blind-results-b2.json less the filter's two drops (check_same_thread, pool_pre_ping).
